search_serpstack_web_search: search serpstack web API for a query and return a list of SearchResult objects
search_serpstack_filtered_results: search serpstack web API and filter results by a list of allowed domains
search_serpstack_https_disabled: search serpstack web API using HTTP instead of HTTPS for the API request
search_serpstack_limit_results: search serpstack web API and limit the number of returned results to a count
search_serpstack_query_results: search serpstack web API with a query string and API key to retrieve organic search results
